name: Albescent-Barrow
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by towering mountain ranges. Beyond bioluminescent seas, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Nothing about the temporal distortion zone appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
